our front door is unprotected and boring. We needed some dimension.  I didn’t want to spend a bunch of money seeing this is not my forever house. I love straight lines and I found the perfect awning that really added to my house. The structure is pretty simple but classy. I am So happy with this item

reviews.text:
We have a south facing deck that gets very hot in the sun. This heats our house even with the blinds down. We ordered 16' and 14' motorized Maui oatmeal tweed Awntech awnings and we are extremely happy! We can keep the blinds up now (for the view and nice filtered light) and is far cooler on the deck and inside the house. We ordered the optional soffit/eve brackets and mounted these to the end of our rafter beams (that I quickly power-sanded flat and put a 1"x3" wood mounting pad to lower a bit to clear the rain gutter). My wife and I put the awnings into the brackets without drama! FYI: We ordered the motors to be in the middle (left 16' and right 14') which gave a 7" gap between awning fabrics. If you order to have the motors at the outer ends (when you have two awnings side-by-side), then you would have a 5" gap between the two awning fabrics. The in and out motor stops were already set good at Awntech. It was pretty straight forward to adjust the level of the awnings to match each other.
We are thrilled!
reviews.author: Kent Lines

reviews.text:
We are very happy with both the quality of the product and responsiveness of the service. I initially ordered the wrong size and had to return for correct size. Patricia and Tech support were very accommodating, made the process easy, They unsolicited, offered to reduce the expediting fee, which was very appreciated. Very good quality to price ratio, we saved much time (months) and THOUSANDS vs. local installers. Highly recommend! Only pet peeve is they make it impossible to speak to someone by phone, force you to communicate by email. In the end it worked out fine, but frustrating none the less.

UPDATE:
Original purchase still holding up and look great a year later surviving some pretty rough weather in between. Liked them enough to order another for a different part of house. The order came promptly and looks great!
reviews.author: Peter Dessak

reviews.text: My wife and I ordered 3 Dallas Retro Style Awnings and are quite pleased with the outcome. Not too difficult to assemble and mount. The fabric looks great and we've received numerous compliments. I needed to modify one of the awnings to accomodate mounting to a brick facade and was able to do that with not much trouble. The only small complaint I have is that the velcro strip stitched on one of the fabric awnings was off the mark by an inch making it nearly impossible to stretch all the way to fit the front bar. Fortunately, enough of the receiver strip was able to latch on so the awning doesnt fly off in a wind gust. But it was close! All in all we're pleased and consider it to be a good value.
reviews.author: Richard Wilbers

reviews.text: Secure shipping from Texas.  Went up easily but definitely needed 3 people to put up our 18 foot awning.  We live on a seacoast and needed the breeze barrier attachments as an accessory because the wind made the awning dangerously close to being damaged.  It would do well for Awntech to suggest this for seashore customers. After the breeze poles were installed we could enjoy the awning shade most of the time and are very happy with the purchase.  Our deck was previously scorched by the sun and was unusable at certain times.

reviews.text:

reviews.text: We are quite pleased with the look of our new awning. My wife loves all things French and we were looking for the perfect accent for our entrance. This gives us that charming look and feel of being on a small, narrow street outside of Paris, France. I had some questions regarding the specific measurements of our model awning and customer service was quick to help. When it came time to actually install the fabric into the frame, once again, customer service had the helpful suggestion that turned what could have been a frustrating process into a "piece of cake". Our awning is well designed, well built and we anticipate it lasting for years...and they sell replacement fabric awnings to either change the look or replace it once it gets worn looking from years of continuous exposure. Thanks Patty at Awntech!

The metal of the crank hook tore like paper under pressure of rewinding the awning. I am unable to close the awning today. The awning is a replacement of prior Awntech awning that lasted 20 years.The current awning was installed summer 2024. I would not recommend buying this product through a retailer. Buy direct.

reviews.text:
This is a poor-quality product. I ordered top of the line 18 x12 ft. motorized awning. Problems started when I installed it.

1. Bad tubular motor. You will need to adjust tension of the material using special tool for the motor. Once I started the adjustment process, the motor stopped working. After 30-45 minutes of waiting, motor started working again and so on. Awntech stated motor only works for short time before it overheats and stops. Then you need to wait for the motor to cool down. Awntech knows about this problem, but they do not disclose it upfront. Pure misrepresentation of the product. Interestingly, Awntech gives only a ONE-year warranty for the motor - they know it's a low quality motor, yet their website boasts about high quality low price awnings. Not true.

2. Quality of material is subpar. My awning was sewn from 4 different pieces of material. Awntech representative stated (via email) this is the only way material comes - 60" wide and "everyone" puts it together - pure misrepresentation considering There are wide awnings made as one-piece material. As a result awning was sagging a lot. If you are OK with it, it's fine; to me it looks bad.

3. Cheaply made product overall. Materials are of poor quality.

4. Return policy is bad they charge me 25% restocking fee plus shipping back - basically blackmail me to keeping this poor-quality awning.  I would rather lose money but get a better-quality product.

5. Poor customer service.  Noone answers phone calls.  Communication is via e-mail only, and it takes days to get a response.  I understand that their prices are lower than higher-quality awnings, but still, you need to have some sort of basic customer service.

I would highly recommend getting a different product. Yes, you will pay more money, but this is a purchase that should last for many years. Not only you will enjoy a better quality, but you will also feel good about it.

I am getting a different product and should have listened to others - don't be a sucker like me! :)

reviews.text: I ordered 7 Dallas Retro awnings for our 1930 Phoenix bungalow.  I was careful to manage my expectation for internet awnings, but they arrived in a timely manner, the awnings were as I ordered them, and I was pleasantly surprised by the construction quality.  The color swatches helped me make the correct fabric selection.  The design made mounting the awnings relatively easy (the 10 and 12 footers did require some help from my buddy to pull the fabric through the top bar channel).  I am pleased with the result and am getting positive comments from the neighbors.  For a high value DIY awning project, I recommend Awntech!

I had some problem connecting the remote at the start of our spring season, but Patty with tech support emailed me trouble shooting tips and updated manuals and that help solve my problem. reviews.text: Ordered 2 Destin 10x8 ft. manual retractable awnings. Overall quality appears to be good so far. However, upon arrival, each awning had a problem with the canopy mounting bracket on one end. The bracket mounting screws were stripped out resulting in the bracket not being attached to the awning frame on one end. It was obvious that the person responsible had problems and had tried screw in the self-tapping screws in several spots. The same person must have worked on both awnings as they both had the same problem on one end of the awning. Very sloppy work and disappointing that the awnings were shipped that way. Evidently no one is checking them before shipping. Luckily, I was able to purchase larger diameter screws and DRILL PILOT HOLES to mount the bracket to the awning. Sent in pictures to the customer email to make the company aware of the issue but received no acknowledgement. This is the reason for the 4 star review.

reviews.text: Received excellent customer and technical support from Awntech for the install and programming of the motor on my new 14" motorized awning. It looks great and works perfectly.

reviews.text: I purchased one of the blue canvas awnings. It arrived in a few days. A friend and I put it up in about 1 hr. This is not a motorized unit, just a 4' wide canvas awning. reviews.text: We purchased a motorized Awntech canopy nearly 10 years ago from Home Depot.  It has done a beautiful job of shading our deck during the summer,  and is easy to put away when the sun is down or just behind the trees.  It has been very durable and kept its attractiveness until the last couple of years (several years past it's warranty).  Our last two very wet and windy winters  have taken their toll on the canvas although the motor still runs great.  The valance is in shreds and the canvas is stained.  We reached out to Awntech directly to see about getting a replacement canvas.  They have been wonderful to work with.   I first contacted them through their after hours "chat."  Daniel got back to me quickly the next day and answered all the questions I sent via email.  He even provided instructions on how to replace the canvas, so that I would know if it was easy enough to do to make it worth replacing instead of repurchasing.  He then put me in touch with a customer service person to place my order with.  Samantha was great.  It was so refreshing to have one person to work with through the entire process.  She was patient, knowledgeable, and very helpful.  Samantha made great suggestions, including sending us fabric samples when we couldn't decide between all the choices.  She was very prompt in replying to all my emails, and very positive in her manner.   It makes me very happy to be able to replace the canvas for a little over half what it would cost to replace the entire canopy.  I save money and the environment by keeping one more item out of the landfill .  I will highly recommend Awntech to anyone who wants an attractive and durable canopy for their deck or porch.

After installing the replacement awning I noticed that it was 10 inches to short on the width and looked like it didn't belong to this awning. I called Awntech and was assigned to a customer service tech named Lilly Konda. She worked with me on what we needed to correct this issue. (measure the old awning) so we could have a new awning made to correct size due to changes made to manufacturing since the original awning was made. I gave her the measurements and she had a new awning sent to us. When this awning arrived it was the wrong fabric. I again called Awntech and talked to Lilly and she looked at the pictures I sent her of new awning and she didn't know or couldn't explain how the wrong fabric was used to make the new awning, but never the less my wife didn't like the new fabric so again Lilly ordered a new awning with correct fabric and had it shipped to me. When the new awning arrived I opened it and it was the correct fabric so I installed it and it fit and looks fantastic. I want the powers to be know that I do customer service at the customer's site for over 27 years and the way that your customer service tech (Lilly Konda) handled this was very professional and I would expect that our customer service techs should be as professional as she was with all the issues that arrived while working with me. Yes it took 3 times to get it right but nothing was her fault just a mix up of old and new and she made it that so I would not go any where else to get parts or service for my Awntech awning.
Please thank her for a GREAT JOB and her Professional customer service.
Sincerely Yours
Thomas Fitzgerald
Senior Service Tech
OMAX Corp.
